messages:
harper: Heads-up from the onboarding workshop: the curl example in /guides/runtime/verify-assets is returning 403 when attendees copy the image URL (breaks demos).

noah: Which link exactly? We had a batch of presigned shortlinks that expired after the last IAM rotation.

harper: It's the codeblock under 'Verify static assets' — `curl https://short.redwood/onboarding/splash.png -O`. Repro: copy/paste from the rendered page into terminal and it fails.

jin: Quick fix: swap the shortlink for the mapped internal asset path `/assets/docs/runtime/splash.png`. That avoids presigned expiry and preserves CDN behavior.

harper: Perfect. Can you open a tiny PR with that swap and include staging preview steps? Workshop is tomorrow morning.

jin: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4782 title: "docs(runtime): replace ephemeral shortlink in verify-assets example" assignee: jin. Description includes sed one-liner to sweep other instances and a note to run staging preview.

noah: I'll review in 15m. Also +1 for a lint rule to fail if `short.redwood` appears in fenced code blocks; we keep hitting this. Could file a follow-up issue after the PR lands.

docs-bot: PR merged by noah : https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4782  deployed to staging.

jin: Verified staging preview; example copies cleanly and image fetch returns 200. Follow-up issue created: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/issues/1347 "lint: detect short.redwood in codeblocks". Closing the loop, thanks! :thumbsup:
